docs_facts.fact: GA. Set citations: {enabled: true} on document blocks (all or none in one request); Claude returns citation entries pointing at exact passages. Location types: char_location (plain text), page_location (PDF), content_block_location (custom content). cited_text does not count toward output tokens. Only text citations are supported (no image citations). Incompatible with structured outputs (400). Source documents, not citation blocks, can be cached.
docs_facts.exam_era_risk: API version 2026-10-21 rejects a non-empty citations array on text blocks in user messages (400); the enabled setting on documents and search results is still accepted.

docs_facts.fact: Block of type search_result with required source (URL or any stable id), title and content (array of text blocks) and optional citations {enabled}. Can be returned from a tool_result or placed top-level in user content; Claude then cites them with search_result_location citations. No beta header; supported on all active models. Citations setting must match across results in a request.
